### Create your branch{.unnumbered}

For each practical session, the teacher provides a starting branch: `tp<N>-start`.

You will have to create a personal branch: `<username>-tp<N>` (e.g. *camille-tp2*) and work on your own branch.

To start with a clean and up-to-date codebase:

- [ ] `git fetch origin` to retrieve the latest information from your remote repository
- [ ] `git fetch upstream` to retrieve the latest information from the teacher's repository
- [ ] Create (and switch to) your branch: `git switch -c <username>-tp<N> upstream/tp<N>-start`
- [ ] `git push -u origin <username>-tp<N>` to publish your branch on the remote

Then use the standard Git cycle: add, commit, push after each part.
